description: This file defines the profile settings UI components for the Notesnook application, including user profile management, account actions, and session controls.

classes.name: SettingsGroup
classes.description: Type defining a group of user profile settings, including key, section, header, visibility, and individual settings.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Component representing the user's profile section in the settings.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Registers a listener for changes in user login state.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Function invoked when user interacts with various UI components, such as changing email, managing attachments, saving recovery key, deleting account, or logging out.
